annotations.title: Read a result with a digest receipt

description: Read a published protocol result and request an entry in the public transparency log holding a digest of the answer. The receipt is not a quote, not a price guarantee and not proof of delivery. Nothing is bought, paid or sent to a counterparty; publication reads may contact external sources. Confirm transition.receipt.reference through MCP verify_astranl with ref, A2A SendMessage with message.metadata.skill=verify and ref in a data part, or HTTPS GET https://astranl.com/api/protocol/read/verify?ref=REFERENCE. An optional answer_sha256 checks the answer digest. A receipt may be unavailable or pending log inclusion; confirmation states its current limits.

demand.description: One demand line; catalog matches are candidates.

site.description: Bare public domain or HTTPS site origin, with no path or query.

ref.description: Any AstraNL reference: action receipt ASTRA-A-..., policy receipt ASTRA-R-..., consumption or agreement certificate ASTRA-C-..., log event alk_..., attestation att_/atr_..., ingress receipt RCPT-n

name: read_with_receipt
